mission.objective: Implement ONLY compact pure-stdlib metadata/timestamp/observation support helpers and synthetic tests for the already frozen P16 M0 feasibility mission. Do not execute any scientific/data acquisition task.

instructions.context: Read FEASIBILITY_REGISTRATION.json for frozen scientific boundaries. Work directory is an isolated new P16 folder. No old package imports. Parent will acquire/inspect authorized data after independent review. The exact frozen registration is copied into this small code-only directory; original source remains unchanged in parent. Do not modify the copied registration.
requirements: Create core.py and test_core.py only; use Python standard library to allow saved/synthetic reproduction without a model environment. No network/data/model access.
Provide sha256(path), read_json(path), dump_json(path,value) using utf-8 and explicit LF, allow_nan=False. dump writes safely; no invalid dates/source information invented.

Provide exact finite binary64 round-trip serialization helpers using struct pack bits hex and float.hex; NaN/inf explicitly flagged/missingness represented rather than rounding; strict_past_index(sorted_times,bin_start) uses bisect_left minus1 and equality excluded, validates finite/nondecreasing times.

Implement count_bins(spikes,edges,support,invalid_intervals) with half-open [a,b) boundaries and exact finite original edges. Require whole bin covered by explicit union support; return None for invalid/missing observation, preserve actual zero integers. Gaps reset by separate presentation groups; do not infer support from spike min/max. Validate original interval ordinal/ID preservation helper.
Implement source_qualified(row): quality==good; amplitude_cutoff<=.1,presence_ratio>=.95,isi_violations<=.5,allfinite; explicit values not SDKdefaults.

Implement metadata_populations(sessions,probes,channels,units) with exact ID joins and VISp/VISp1/VISp2/3/VISp4/VISp5/VISp6a/VISp6b only; perprobe anatomy+qualified unit counts and IDs; one session chosen by earliest acquisition date among eligible>=8,then numeric sessionID; selectedprobe maximalqualifiedVISpcount,then numericprobeID. All source sessions/probes retained in inventory with qualifiedtiers5/8/12/20. No pooling. Mouse key specimen_id. Unmapped/nonfinite/QCbad rows explicit excluded reasons. Ignore precomputed response scores; no feature fitting. Expose APIs with clear docstrings.

Implement allocate_roles(selected_populations,historical_session_ids,historical_final_session_ids) deterministic SHA256(mission+specimenID). All history/protected overlaps ineligible for Final. IfN>=16/fresh>=8 reserve min(N//2,Nfresh) fresh mice and keep>=8Dev; else allDev temporalexploratory. Pilot chooser separately excludes everyFinal and historicalFinal; prefer one each session type brain_observatory_1.1/functional_connectivity, min frozen declared NWB bytes then numeric sessionID; exactly<=2. Parent supplies source sizes and freezes IDs before any arrays. Do not silently choose alternative after observations.

Implement a small payload TransferBudget helper that durably accounts bytes before accepting chunks and refuses total>6000000000, supports saved failures/partial counters, no crypto/key architecture or unbounded retries. Ordinary JSON evidence only; no network code.

Write compact meaningful unittest regressions for exact equality+nextafter, float64bit preservation, zero vs unsupported/invalid bins, original boundaries/gaps, missing running/pupil values, QC thresholds/NaN, no crossprobe pooling/duplicate mouse inference, frozen independent roles/noFinalpilots, cap/refusedoverflow preservingpreviouscharges. Keep tests synthetic; no actual neural data files, fitting, scoring, likelihood, statistic hypothesis calls or searches.
At end report public API names/signatures and exact tests run.
constraints: Modify only core.py and test_core.py. Do not modify FEASIBILITY_REGISTRATION, .gitignore, source rights, manifests or any parent paths.
No real data, URLs, network, pip downloads, oldworker imports, models, cohorts outcome access, git mutation or external communication. No secrets.
Use current configured Codex model; do not choose/override model. No subagents. No invented results. No filesystem enumeration above this isolated staging folder.
nonGoals: No full implementation/research mission closeout in this child CLI. Parent completes acquisition, protocol/report, review and Git gates.

criteria: Both files exist and synthetics pass; exact boundary/QC/role/budget semantics per freeze.
